headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 10, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Aaron Nola leading the Phillies' pitching effort. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, while the Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-5. The Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds 4-0, with Hunter Greene earning the win.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Konnor Griffin of the Pittsburgh Pirates being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury. Other players on the injured list include Kyle Harrison of the Milwaukee Brewers, Victor Bericoto of the San Francisco Giants, Mick Abel of the Minnesota Twins, Zack Gelof of the Athletics, Mark Vientos of the New York Mets, Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals, and Matt McLain of the Cincinnati Reds.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have made two notable roster moves, acquiring left-handed pitcher Brandon Eisert from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer 10-2 Loss to Tigers**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies fell short in a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, who took the game 10-2. Aaron Nola led the Phillies' pitching effort, striking out 8 batters in 5 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals in their latest matchup. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles taking the win. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs were defeated by the Cincinnati Reds 4-0, with Hunter Greene earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 12 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Griffin Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Konnor Griffin has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury. Griffin's status has been updated.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire LHP Brandon Eisert in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired left-handed pitcher Brandon Eisert from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jaden Woods and future considerations. Eisert joins the Pirates' roster following the trade.
